name: support-intent-observatory-alan-vo
summary: Train and evaluate a local TF-IDF intent classifier from labeled customer support tickets, analyze confusion matrices, and triage uncertain tickets into human review queues.
workflows: Train and evaluate local TF-IDF intent classification models with n-gram tokenization and calibrate confidence scoring
